scopeBoundaries: Do not re-audit provider routing or generator terminal-state ownership; pair 03 supplies those conclusions. Read only their journal/lease/serialization edges here.
Pair 04 owns memory quality, compaction/recall, and memory-v2 retention; this shard owns disk persistence and restart edges.
Mutation broker/transaction exact-byte authority belongs to pair 06; process/sandbox execution authority belongs to pair 09.
Pair 12 owns broad task/control-plane completeness; get_task/plan persistence edges are included here.
Named kill-9/recovery tests must be classified by actual behavior (fixture, reopen, runtime integration, or real process kill), without inferring assurance from their titles.
Dedicated daemon/lane services must be traced to actual consumers; names, capability maps, and helper tests alone do not establish runtime wiring.
